note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). Four portal screens and one terminal screen (deploy, run from src on the laptop). Needs a second environment TEST (Production or Sandbox with Dataverse, or a Trial environment) and a private Azure DevOps project in the existing organization devladlog. URLs, connection IDs and variable values are only ever in environment variables, never printed.
prepare: # owner signs in: pac auth below, Azure DevOps and the browser profiles for labadmin (make.powerapps.com, TEST) and alex.demo (SharePoint, Outlook on the web). Nothing is typed or stored here.

# owner (off camera): IT_SITE_URL (IT Helpdesk Test site), SERVICEDESK_MAILBOX (taylor.demo), CONN_SHAREPOINT and CONN_OFFICE365 (TEST connection IDs, copied from the connection URLs) are set as environment variables in this session
if (-not $env:IT_SITE_URL) { $env:IT_SITE_URL = Read-Host 'IT Helpdesk Test site URL' }; if (-not $env:SERVICEDESK_MAILBOX) { $env:SERVICEDESK_MAILBOX = Read-Host 'Service desk mailbox' }
if (-not $env:CONN_SHAREPOINT) { $env:CONN_SHAREPOINT = Read-Host 'TEST SharePoint connection ID' }; if (-not $env:CONN_OFFICE365) { $env:CONN_OFFICE365 = Read-Host 'TEST Outlook connection ID' }
pac auth create --name dev --environment $env:DEV_URL   # owner signs in, off camera
pac auth create --name test --environment $env:TEST_URL   # owner signs in, off camera

# owner (tenant, demo.md Setup 1-6): publisher contoso, solution IT Request Notices (ITRequestNotices) with release 1.0.0.0 imported into DEV and flows on; second site IT Helpdesk Test with a copy of IT Requests (alex.demo member); connections for SharePoint and Outlook in DEV and TEST

Push-Location .\src; pac solution export --name ITRequestNotices --path ..\out\ITRequestNotices.zip --overwrite; pac solution export --name ITRequestNotices --path ..\out\ITRequestNotices_managed.zip --managed --overwrite; pac solution unpack --zipfile ..\out\ITRequestNotices.zip --folder ..\out\unpacked --packagetype Both; Pop-Location

# owner (Azure DevOps, demo.md Setup 7): private project mglab-alm with this src as repo root, Power Platform Build Tools extension, service connections, variable groups alm-test and alm-prod, environments test and prod (Approvals check on prod), pipelines export-from-dev.yml and release.yml; run release.yml until Prod waits for approval

# owner (TEST, demo.md Steps for TEST 1): first install of release 1.0.0.0 into TEST (Update mode); then the deploy screen imports 1.1.0.0; the later 1.1.1.0 Upgrade for the 'upgrade' screen is built with: pac solution version --strategy Solution --solutionPath src\solution

screens.name: solution
steps: Select environment DEV and open Solutions
Open 'IT Request Notices' (unique name ITRequestNotices, version 1.1.0.0) on the 'All' view

Show the one cloud flow 'Acknowledge IT request', the four environment variables (IT site URL, IT Requests list, Service desk mailbox, Environment label) and the two connection references (SharePoint, Office 365 Outlook)
mask: environment URL and ID in the address bar
account name and tenant name in the top bar

screens.name: pipeline
steps: Open the private project mglab-alm > Pipelines and the run of release.yml
Show the stages Build and Test green and the stage Prod waiting for approval
Open the Test stage log on the step 'Render the deployment settings' (tokens already replaced, values masked)
mask: Azure DevOps organization name in the address bar and breadcrumbs
service connection names if they show IDs

screens.name: deploy
mask: the environment URL if the pac output prints it
never cat the rendered settings file (connection IDs)

screens.name: test
steps: Select environment TEST and open Solutions > 'IT Request Notices' (managed)
Show the flow 'Acknowledge IT request' with status On and the connection references bound to connections
Open the environment variable 'Environment label' and show the current value TEST
Second capture: as alex.demo add the item 'Second monitor' to IT Requests on the test site, then in Outlook on the web show the mail 'IT request #<n> received [TEST]'
mask: environment URL and ID in the address bar

screens.name: upgrade
steps: Environment TEST, Solutions > 'IT Request Notices', Cloud flows view. Capture 1: after release 1.0.0.0 was installed and 1.1.0.0 imported as Update, both flows are listed, 'Weekly stale summary' still present
Import the later build 1.1.1.0 as Upgrade from the terminal (Deploy-Solution.ps1 -Mode Upgrade), refresh the Cloud flows view. Capture 2: only 'Acknowledge IT request' remains
Capture 3: open Environment variables and show that 'Stale after days' is gone
If the flow is still there after the upgrade keep that on screen: the narration and README are fixed to match
mask: environment URL and ID in the address bar

teardown: # owner (tenant): delete the solution ITRequestNotices in TEST and DEV; delete the TEST environment (or let the trial expire); delete the site IT Helpdesk Test and the TEST connections
# owner (Azure DevOps and Entra): delete the project mglab-alm and its service connections; delete the app registration created by pac admin create-service-principal
Remove-Item Env:IT_SITE_URL, Env:SERVICEDESK_MAILBOX, Env:CONN_SHAREPOINT, Env:CONN_OFFICE365, Env:TEST_URL, Env:DEV_URL -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
